summary.intent: Execute Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) using wave-based parallel execution to extract cryptographic primitives and domain types from the CipherBox desktop app into a Cargo workspace with multiple dedicated crates.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 completed successfully (23-01: Cargo workspace + cipherbox-crypto crate), and Wave 2 was initiated with two parallel agents executing plans 23-02 (cipherbox-core domain types) and 23-03 (api-client + test vectors). The transcript ends mid-wave-2.

repo: Phase 23 branch is `feat/phase-23-rust-sdk-extraction` — branching strategy is 'phase' level
Cargo workspace is being created at repo root with crates under `crates/` directory
CipherBox crypto primitives include: AES-GCM, AES-CTR, ECIES, Ed25519, HKDF, IPNS name derivation
Domain types include: FolderMetadata, FileMetadata, RecycleBinMetadata, DeviceRegistry, vault blob v2, IPNS records

workflow: execute-phase workflow uses wave-based parallelization: wave 1 is serial foundation, wave 2+ can be parallel
Spot-checks after each wave verify: SUMMARY.md exists, git commits present (grep by phase-plan pattern), key files exist on disk, no Self-Check: FAILED marker
Pre-wave dependency checks run `verify key-links` before spawning wave N+1 agents
STATE.md is updated at phase start via `gsd-tools state begin-phase` before any plan execution
